title: Multiple Branches with elif
concept: Use elif ('else if') to chain multiple conditions — check one, then another, then another.
why: Real decisions often have more than two outcomes. elif lets you handle grade levels, menu options, or any multi-way choice.
tips: `elif` is short for 'else if' — it's one word in XIOM
Only the FIRST matching branch runs — order matters!
Put the most specific conditions first, most general last
The final `else` is optional but catches anything that didn't match
common_mistakes: Writing `else if` instead of `elif` — XIOM uses `elif`
Putting conditions in the wrong order (general before specific)
Forgetting that only ONE branch runs per if/elif/else chain
